Through professional internships, academic projects, and teaching experience, I have developed skills in marketing analytics, digital strategy, and communication.

title: Customizing Quarto with CSS and SCSS
text:
CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to customize the appearance of websites, including typography, colors, spacing, and layout.
SCSS (Sassy CSS) extends CSS by allowing developers to use variables, nesting, and reusable styling patterns.
These technologies help create websites that are visually consistent, accessible, and professional.

text:
Learning Reflection
This assignment strengthened my understanding of how Quarto can be used to create and publish professional websites.
I gained hands-on experience developing website navigation, organizing content, building dashboards, applying custom styling, and implementing automated portfolio listings.
I also learned how to use GitHub and GitHub Pages to share analytical work with a broader audience.
These skills will be valuable for communicating future marketing research findings, developing analytics reports, and presenting professional projects.
